$response): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n\n        if (!isset($body['id']) || (!is_string($body['id']) && !is_numeric($body['id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && !is_numeric($body['name']))\n            || !isset($body['max_players']) || !is_numeric($body['max_players'])) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $id = (string) $body['id'];\n        $name = (string) $body['name'];\n        $maxPlayers = (int) $body['max_players'];\n        if ($id === '' || $name === '' || $maxPlayers < 1) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->findPlayCampaign($id) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign id already exists']);\n        }\n\n        $campaign = [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ];\n        $this->db->createPlayCampaign($campaign);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 201, [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function joinCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requirePlayer($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['character_id']) || (!is_string($body['character_id']) && !is_numeric($body['character_id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && !is_numeric($body['name']))\n            || !isset($body['class']) || (!is_string($body['class']) && !is_numeric($body['class']))) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => ($this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndUser($campaignId, $actor['username']) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'already a member']);\n        }\n\n        if function startCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['owner'] !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['status'] !== 'lobby') {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign already started']);\n        }\n\n        $members = $this->db->findPlayMembers($campaignId);\n        if (count($members) < 2) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'insufficient party members']);\n        }\n\n        $currentActor = $members[0]['username'];\n        $this->db->startPlayCampaign($campaignId, $currentActor, 1);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 200, [\n            'id' => $campaignId,\n            'status' => 'active',\n            'current_actor' => $currentActor,\n            'turn_number' => 1,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function setSessionZero(Request $request, Response return (string) $owner;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Check that a value is an integer within the supplied range.\n     */\n    private function isValidInteger(mixed $value, int $min = PHP_INT_MIN, int $max = PHP_INT_MAX): bool\n    {\n        if (is_int($value)) {\n            return $value >= $min && $value <= $max;\n        }\n        if (is_string($value) && preg_match('/^-?\\d+$/', $value)) {\n $response): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n\n        if (!isset($body['id']) || (!is_string($body['id']) && !is_numeric($body['id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && !is_numeric($body['name']))\n            || !isset($body['max_players']) || !is_numeric($body['max_players'])) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $id = (string) $body['id'];\n        $name = (string) $body['name'];\n        $maxPlayers = (int) $body['max_players'];\n        if ($id === '' || $name === '' || $maxPlayers < 1) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->findPlayCampaign($id) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign id already exists']);\n        }\n\n        $campaign = [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ];\n        $this->db->createPlayCampaign($campaign);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 201, [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function joinCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requirePlayer($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['character_id']) || (!is_string($body['character_id']) && !is_numeric($body['character_id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && !is_numeric($body['name']))\n            || !isset($body['class']) || (!is_string($body['class']) && !is_numeric($body['class']))) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => ($this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndUser($campaignId, $actor['username']) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'already a member']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->countPlayMembers($campaignId) >= $campaign['max_players']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'party is full']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'character id already exists']);\n        }\n\n 'class' => $class,\n        ];\n        $this->db->createPlayMember($member);\n\n        $this->initializeSpellSlots($campaignId, $characterId, $class, 1);\n\n        return respondJson($response, function startCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['owner'] !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['status'] !== 'lobby') {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign already started']);\n        }\n\n        $members = $this->db->findPlayMembers($campaignId);\n        if (count($members) < 2) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'insufficient party members']);\n        }\n\n WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND gold >= ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$gold, $campaignId, $fromCharacterId, $gold]);\n            if ($stmt->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE character_currency SET gold = gold + ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$gold, $campaignId, $toCharacterId]);\n\n            $fromBalance = $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $fromCharacterId)['gold'];\n            $toBalance = $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $toCharacterId)['gold'];\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO currency_transfers (campaign_id, transfer_id, from_character_id, to_character_id, gold, from_gold, to_gold) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $transferId, $fromCharacterId, $toCharacterId, $gold, $fromBalance, $toBalance]);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return [\n                'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n                'transfer_id' => $transferId,\n                'from_character_id' => $fromCharacterId,\n                'to_character_id' => $toCharacterId,\n                'gold' => $gold,\n                'from_gold' => $fromBalance,\n                'to_gold' => $toBalance,\n            ];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function createPlayCampaign(array $campaign): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaigns (id, name, owner, status, max_players) WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND gold >= ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$gold, $campaignId, $fromCharacterId, $gold]);\n            if ($stmt->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE character_currency SET gold = gold + ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$gold, $campaignId, $toCharacterId]);\n\n            $fromBalance = $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $fromCharacterId)['gold'];\n            $toBalance = $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $toCharacterId)['gold'];\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO currency_transfers (campaign_id, transfer_id, from_character_id, to_character_id, gold, from_gold, to_gold) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $transferId, $fromCharacterId, $toCharacterId, $gold, $fromBalance, $toBalance]);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return [\n                'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n                'transfer_id' => $transferId,\n                'from_character_id' => $fromCharacterId,\n                'to_character_id' => $toCharacterId,\n                'gold' => $gold,\n                'from_gold' => $fromBalance,\n                'to_gold' => $toBalance,\n            ];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function createPlayCampaign(array $campaign): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaigns (id, name, owner, status, max_players)
